Hi Sara — thanks for the files and the clear ask. Quick response with a proposed path: 

1) Evidence: I'll attach our Redwood_DPA_Template_v2.docx and share our latest SOC 2 report + subprocessors link below. That should satisfy the initial evidence ask.
2) Redlines: I reviewed §4.3 (retention). Small carveouts usually require legal review but not exec signoff unless retention >7yrs or controlled data residency exceptions. We'll mark that as an escalation item.
3) SCCs: Redwood typically executes the DPA with SCC Annex where required. If Acme requires us to sign a counter-SCC, we can do that but need a short legal turn (1–2 business days).
4) Signature flow: DocuSign is fine. We generally route signature to: Legal -> Revenue Ops -> CEO (only for material exceptions). For standard redlines we can do a Legal + Revenue Ops signature.

I'll loop in our legal and revenue ops to confirm routing and confirm whether the retention redline triggers exec review.

Links/evidence:
- SOC 2 report (read-only): https://redwood-inference.example.com/reports/soc2-2027.pdf
- Subprocessors & locations: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD_Acme-DPA-evidence

—Marissa
